# calabash-cucumber

**Tag**: web, testing

## 简介

calabash-cucumber drives tests for native iOS apps. You must link your app with calabash-ios-server framework to execute tests.

## 官网

- 主页: http://calaba.sh
- 文档: http://calabashapi.xamarin.com/ios/
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/calabash/calabash-ios/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/calabash-cucumber
